title: Mount Amulet
description: A simple item that can store your mount, but only one!. Reusable and cheap!
body:
<< WARNING! THIS PRODUCT IS AI SLOP! It was made assisted by Codex. The very ugly item is mine though >>

A very cheap amulet that is reusable and stores one of your mounts by right-clicking on it.
To release the mount, you can right-click again on the air and the mount will spawn back in front of you, or right-click in a block and the mount will spawn back above that block. It's very simple!
